verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a Zapier integration where its webhooks trigger Zapier to fetch transcripts once meetings are processed, and uploadAudio supports a completion webhook. That covers the 'thousands of apps via Zapier' part of the story, though it relies on webhooks rather than a turnkey connector. There is no evidence of native Slack channel or Notion page delivery. Missing for 10: native Slack integration, native Notion integration, evidence that summaries or notes (not just transcripts) are pushed automatically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
